activity_summary: At Aylesbury you paid a penny for one ballad-sheet. You said it was for a girl who cannot read, and who would have it at one hearing. You did not buy a second, and neither of you gave the sheet a title.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Chose one sheet, paid, and did not ask its name.

facets.activity: Bought a ballad-sheet for a penny

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It is for a girl who cannot read it

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
